summary.zh: 流程设计、OKR 执行与运营节奏
summary.en: Operations leadership help for process, OKRs and cadence

description.zh: 面向运营负责人，处理流程设计、OKR 推进、经营节奏、瓶颈排查和规模化打法。可以跟踪 OKR 进度并分析运营效率。适合公司扩张期流程开始变乱、会议变多但推进变慢的时候。
description.en: Operations leadership support across process design, OKR execution, operating cadence, bottleneck hunting and scaling playbooks. Tracks OKRs and analyzes efficiency. Fits a company outgrowing its processes.
